USB_VBUS_RAW.rule: Route the connector-side high-current escape explicitly before any low-risk batch.

USB_5V.rule: Preserve the reviewed current path and local input loop; do not treat all endpoints as one generic multipoint route.

3V3.rule: Build the reviewed trunk and supply islands before bias branches; never use a pull-up branch as a series supply feed.

krt_prerequisite_gate.name: critical_power_before_low_risk_krt
krt_prerequisite_gate.rule: Do not start a low-risk KRT batch until the critical power path is connected; critical power, ground return and USB data probes remain permitted.

ordered_scopes.name: usb_type_c_connector_fanout
ordered_scopes.rule: Complete or atomically include earlier fine-pitch connector escapes before routing a later group.
